tools.name: rentals.search
tools.description: Return a compact, actionable shortlist of published furnished apartments by location, availability, capacity, rooms, duration, and monthly rent. Defaults to 10 available or upcoming rentals; call rentals.get for complete details.

tools.name: rentals.get
tools.description: Return localized customer-safe apartment details, verified availability, duration pricing, deposit, included services, terms, eligibility, media, and inquiry/application links.

jobs.get
tools.description: Read one published role and its email application instructions using jobId from jobs.search. This does not send an application or make a hiring decision.

tools.name: contact.submit
tools.description: Send a customer-confirmed apartment inquiry, corporate housing request, resident support report, or general question through the same website intake. Resident support accepts only photo upload tokens from contact.upload_photo; it grants no access to tenancy records. May send the existing receipt ema

tools.name: contact.upload_photo
tools.description: Upload one customer-approved JPEG or PNG support photo, up to 5 MiB, as base64. The shared image sanitizer strips metadata and returns a single-use 30-minute upload token for contact.submit. Arbitrary URLs and storage keys are not accepted. Keep the idempotencyKey stable for retries.

tools.name: applications.get
tools.description: Read the customer-editable fields and current version of the email-verified request session. This result contains the session owner's personal information and must remain within that customer's context. Unverified, expired and revoked sessions are refused.

tools.name: applications.list_documents
tools.description: List document metadata owned by the email-verified request session. Use documentId with applications.get_document or applications.remove_document. Returns no storage keys or employee data.

tools.name: applications.get_document
tools.description: Return an authenticated binary-download URL for one document owned by the email-verified session. The link contains a scoped credential: do not share or log it. Use documentId from applications.list_documents.

tools.name: applications.remove_document
tools.description: Remove one explicitly selected document from an editable, email-verified request draft, using documentId from applications.list_documents and the current version. Submitted requests remain locked; exact retries replay the receipt.

tools.name: inquiries.activate
tools.description: Activate the email-verified draft as a viewing inquiry, using its current version and explicit customer confirmation. Existing inquiries are reused. Submitted requests cannot switch back to an inquiry.

tools.name: applications.withdraw
tools.description: Record the customer's explicit loss of interest in the owning inquiry and cancel its arrangements through the same website workflow. Once a Request owns the journey, contact the team instead; this tool cannot cancel a contract or tenancy.

tools.name: viewings.cancel
tools.description: Cancel a future confirmed appointment or withdraw the customer's own pending proposal. Use appointmentId or proposalId from viewings.get_details, current request version, and explicit confirmation. This may send the existing cancellation communication.

tools.name: viewings.get_details
tools.description: Read session-owned proposals, availability windows, appointments, and post-viewing feedback versions. Includes only customer-facing information and viewing instructions currently released to this customer by the canonical owner; internal notes and unreleased or revoked contact details are excluded.

tools.name: viewings.request_contact
tools.description: Ask elron club to arrange the resident contact for one SHARE_TENANT_CONTACT arrangement returned by viewings.get_details. Requires an owning verified inquiry, exact version and explicit customer confirmation. This never releases contact data or changes resident permission; read get_details later for

tools.name: viewings.respond_after_viewing
tools.description: Record PROCEED, NOT_INTERESTED, NEEDS_ALTERNATIVES or ANOTHER_VIEWING for one elapsed appointment from viewings.get_details. Requires the current request version, exact feedbackVersion and explicit customer confirmation. Proceeding does not submit a Request or create a booking.

tools.name: viewings.proceed_without_viewing
tools.description: Record the customer's explicit decision to continue the rental journey without a viewing. Uses the verified session, exact version and stable idempotency key; all separate Request approval and legal gates remain in force.

tools.name: applications.select_rental
tools.description: Select a published apartment by rentalId from rentals.search within the customer's verified, editable inquiry context. Existing selection and stage rules are enforced by the website service; submitted requests cannot change apartments.

tools.name: applications.set_consents
tools.description: Record the verified customer's explicit privacy, credit-check and truth-confirmation choices on an editable draft. Each boolean is the customer's actual choice; this does not submit a Request or sign a contract.

tools.name: viewings.set_availability
tools.description: Add one to five future availability windows to the verified inquiry. Times are ISO 8601 with timezone offsets; endAt must follow startAt. This does not confirm an appointment.

tools.name: portal.request_access
tools.description: Request the existing secure resident-portal access email for the customer's own address. Always returns the same generic acknowledgement, without disclosing tenancy existence, identity, access codes or links. Identity verification and personal tenant actions remain in the private resident portal.

tools.name: viewings.decline_proposals
tools.description: Decline one or more exact pending elron club proposals from viewings.get_details in one version-bound, customer-confirmed operation. Only the selected proposals are changed; later offers are preserved.

tools.name: waitlist.confirm
tools.description: Confirm an older newsletter invitation only with its separate confirmation token and the customer's explicit consent. Current availability signup activates immediately; this tool never manufactures a confirmation token.

tools.name: waitlist.preferences.get
tools.description: Use the opaque Manage regions token from an update email to read the selected regions and current version. Returns no internal contact or building identifiers.

tools.name: waitlist.preferences.update
tools.description: Add or remove one exact region, or unsubscribe from all updates, using an opaque Manage regions token, the version from waitlist.preferences.get and a stable UUID idempotency key. Adding a region requires explicit customer consent. Stale state fails unchanged; an uncertain result must be reconciled

tools.name: rentals.check_availability

tools.name: rentals.get_pricing
tools.description: Return current published monthly pricing by supported duration, parking, deposit, inclusions, payment method, and minimum-stay terms. Pricing is informational until a quote or hold is issued.

tools.name: applications.start
tools.description: Create or reuse a duplicate-safe applicant workspace for one published rental. Requires explicit current privacy consent and an idempotency key. Email verification is sent to the applicant; the tool never returns the verification URL.

tools.name: applications.get_status
tools.description: Read the privacy-minimized status and next actions for one scoped application session token.

tools.name: applications.update

tools.name: applications.create_document_upload
tools.description: Create a 15-minute, exact-size and exact-content-type signed upload form for one email-verified application at its exact current version.

tools.name: applications.complete_document_upload
tools.description: Verify the uploaded object, content signature, session ownership, expiry, and exact application version before creating the protected document record.

tools.name: applications.upload_document
tools.description: Upload one bounded PDF, JPEG, or PNG identity or company-registry document to an email-verified application using its exact version and a durable idempotency key.

tools.name: applications.submit
tools.description: Submit one complete email-verified application for review using its exact version, explicit current credit-check and truth-confirmation consent, and a durable idempotency key.

tools.name: viewings.get_status
tools.description: Read customer-safe viewing proposals and confirmed viewing state for one email-verified application session.

tools.name: viewings.propose_availability
tools.description: Propose one to five bounded future viewing slots from an email-verified application at its exact version using a durable idempotency key.

tools.name: viewings.respond_to_proposal
tools.description: Accept or decline one pending Elron Club proposal with explicit confirmation, an exact application version, and a durable idempotency key. Acceptance may send the existing viewing confirmation communication.

tools.name: quotes.create
tools.description: Snapshot customer-safe approved request terms into a 24-hour quote. The application must be submitted, internally approved, due-diligence positive, and solvency passed. This does not hold inventory.

tools.name: quotes.get
tools.description: Read one privacy-minimized quote and its live expiry/availability-hold state using the application session that owns it.

tools.name: quotes.accept
tools.description: With explicit customer confirmation, accept one exact active quote and atomically claim a 30-minute request-owned availability hold. This does not create or sign a contract and does not authorize payment.

tools.name: reservations.get_status
tools.description: Read privacy-minimized hold, contract, signature, payment, reservation, or confirmation state for one application session.

tools.name: contracts.get_signing_link
tools.description: Return a secure signing URL only when the active signer invitation email matches the email-verified application session. Human verification, review, and signature remain in the signing flow.

tools.name: payments.get_status
tools.description: Return due and received payment truth for the scoped application. An approved human-action URL is returned only from an exact, unexpired provider session; no authorization URL is fabricated.

tools.name: bookings.get_confirmation
tools.description: Return a privacy-minimized booking confirmation only after the request has converted into the authoritative Stay workflow.
